factProposals.value: Vendor staff without TxDOT-approved cyber security training completed in the last 365 days are blocked from protected actions; a security officer can suspend clearance pending retraining.

A security breach is logged as a severity-1 incident; with personal data involved, notification is due within 60 days under Tex. Bus. & Com. Code 521.053, and the breach cannot be closed until it is recorded.

decisions.statement: Compliance is enforced at the point of access, not only reported: the document store checks clearance on every upload and opening.
decisions.rationale: The acceptance asks that completing training ensures compliance.

limitations.statement: The 365-day validity and the 60-day notice are taken from the plan and the compliance register; TxDOT security and legal should confirm them.
